title: Brahma
brief_description: Stone sculpture of Lord Brahma acquired from Colamb, Sanguem Taluka, Goa.
detailed_description: This sculpture depicts Lord Brahma, the Hindu god of creation and one of the members of the Trimurti. Traditionally represented with four faces symbolizing the four Vedas and the four directions, Brahma signifies wisdom, knowledge, and the origin of the universe. The sculpture displays the refined craftsmanship characteristic of the Kadamba period and reflects the flourishing tradition of medieval temple art in Goa. Acquired from Colamb in Sanguem Taluka, this 13th Century C.E. sculpture is an important example of Shaiva-Vaishnava religious iconography and regional artistic heritage.
